{{Quote|Zonama Sekot's sun is behind us. These two spectacular dancers, the red giant and the white dwarf, with their long spiral tail, are its companions.|[[Charza Kwinn]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="RP" />}}
A '''red giant''' [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] close to a [[Unidentified white dwarf|white dwarf]] in the [[Gardaji Rift/Legends|Gardaji Rift]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Plasma/Legends|Plasma]] from the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] was pulled toward the [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] and then flung outward in a glowing spiral of [[Color/Legends|red]] and purple [[Gas/Legends|gas]], which resembled a large pinwheel and provided an impressive source of illumination in the skies of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Two stars, a red giant and a white dwarf, orbit close to each other. Zonama Sekot circles the third star, a bright yellow sun, which orbits much farther out, several light-months distant.|Charza Kwinn|<ref name="RP" />}}
A [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] [[Star/Legends|star]] was located within a [[Unidentified trinary system (Gardaji Rift)|trinary star system]] in the [[Gardaji Rift/Legends|Gardaji Rift]],<ref name="RP" /> which was part of the [[Gardaji sector/Legends|Gardaji sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Color/Legends|red]] giant [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] close to a [[Unidentified white dwarf|white dwarf]] star. A [[Zonama Sekot's sun|yellow dwarf]] lay at a distance of several [[light-month]]s from the pair and was orbited by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]]<ref name="RP" /> until the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], when the planet left the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] pulled from the red giant a ribbon of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]], which then curled around the smaller star and was flung outward in a long spiral of red and purple ionized [[Gas/Legends|gas]]. The motion of the [[Binary star/Legends|double-star system]] and the gas resembled a large pinwheel that stretched across the northern sky of Zonama Sekot, illuminating the planet both during the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] and at night.<ref name="RP" />

==History==
{{Quote|Wow.|Anakin Skywalker, upon first seeing the red giant&ndash;white dwarf interaction|<ref name="RP" />}}
When they visited Zonama Sekot<ref name="RP" /> in 29 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]; the Human [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|designer]] [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]]; and the [[Priapulin]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Charza Kwinn]] were all impressed by the glowing display of the double-star system.<ref name="RP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The red giant first appeared in ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', a [[2000]] novel written by [[Greg Bear]].<ref name="RP" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book, placed the Gardaji Rift, and therefore the red giant, in grid square M-1.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[2012]] book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' later claimed that during the events of ''Rogue Planet'', Zonama Sekot was situated in square M-3 instead.<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> However, that placement would result in the star system containing the planet at the [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="RP" /> to be located outside of the Gardaji [[Sector/Legends|sector]],<ref name="Outer Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for grid square M-3</ref> in which lay the Gardaji Rift, the location of Zonama Sekot in ''Rogue Planet''.<ref name="RP" /> As a result, this article treats the placement from ''The Essential Reader's Companion'' to be erroneous.
